title: Catalogue 97: unidentified ciphers on BL Add MS 4136 ff. 32-33 (DECODE R2988 margin, R2989 John Wood to Cecil 1568)

steps.what: Tomokiyo unsolved.htm and project throckmorton notes: the Throckmorton text is read; the margin (R2988) and the Wood line (R2989) are the open items.
R2989 Wood line transcribed at 3x zoom, 39 signs; matched to the Moray-Wood symbol families.
Bain ii no. 804 gives the deciphered cipher phrase of Wood's 6 Sept 1568 letter.
Exhaustive alignment of the Bain phrase (letters, nulls, syllable signs; forward and reversed; all substrings) against the line.
R2988 margin tested as mirror or inverted script.
R2988 margin sign inventory attempted; signs could not be fixed reliably from the scan.
Subagent decryption of R2988 main text with Tomokiyo Cipher 1 key; crops misaligned, lines 1-5 only.
Main text re-cut at measured line centres; lines 1-4 read securely, lines 5-15 decode to English with key corrections (x,υ=i; z=m; ∫t=w; Q=be).
Margin identified as a separate text dated '8 … 1559' with a starred insertion block; likely Throckmorton's copy of his 8 July despatch (CSP For. i 947/950).
CSP Foreign vol. 1 pp. 362-369 (BHO): 8 July abstracts only; no verbatim text of the margin or of the 10 July letter.
Margin transcribed (~405 signs, 217 groups, ~80 sign+dot forms, mean group length 1.87, half the groups single signs).
Letter-substitution rejected on group-length statistics; word-sign shorthand/code with no key or crib, so no statistical attack.
HMC Salisbury i (Hatfield calendar): no entry for Wood 6 Sept 1568; Bain ii 804 is the only print.
R2989 non-uniqueness: 200 anneal restarts vs Bain ii quadgrams; 185 beat median real text, 92 mutually distinct gibberish solutions, so the 39-sign line is undetermined.
Margin word-level test: 222 groups, 141 types, 113 hapax, matching English word statistics (140/107); word-sign code; 51% of tokens are hapax, so at most 49% is identifiable without key or crib.

outcome.method_basis: The text reported as read is Throckmorton's own 10 July 1559 letter on f. 32 (R2988), read about 85-90% with Tomokiyo's Cipher 1 key image for Throckmorton's correspondence, with seven values corrected; the Bain crib for the Wood line did not align, and the margin code and the Wood line stay unread.
outcome.notes: Of the ciphertext on the two leaves, Throckmorton's 10 July 1559 letter (f.32) is read ~85-90% (lines 1-4 secure). The f.32 margin (word-sign code, 222 groups) and Wood's 1568 line (39 signs, non-unique) are unread; fraction is over all three texts.

gaps.item: 10 July letter: ~80 of 550 signs in lines 5-14

gaps.detail: word-sign code; needs key or SP 70/5

prior.where: Tomokiyo, cryptiana unsolved.htm, lists both as unidentified
